# 1. Requirements
```{r requirements}

required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2",
  "cluster", "clusterCrit", "factoextra",
  "FPDclustering"
)

installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# 2. Embedding files and set ranges
```{r load}
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

k_vals <- 2:20
all_results <- list()

# Create cashed and plot folders
dir.create("output/pd_cache", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/pd_plots", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/pd_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

# 2.Load saved PD results. Fit embeddings with caching
```{r run}

load_pd_cached_results <- function(embedding_path) {
  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embedding_matrix))

  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

  full_file <- file.path(
    "output/pd_cache",
    paste0("pd_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds")
  )

  if (file.exists(full_file)) {
    return(readRDS(full_file))
  }

  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

  results <- vector("list", length = max(k_vals))
  avg_silhouette <- rep(NA_real_, max(k_vals))
  ch_scores <- rep(NA_real_, max(k_vals))
  prob_silh_scores <- rep(NA_real_, max(k_vals))

  for (k in k_vals) {
    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/pd_cache",
      paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k, ".rds")
    )

    if (!file.exists(cache_file)) next

    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)

    results[[k]] <- list(
      model = cached$model,
      labels = cached$labels,
      silhouette = cached$silhouette,
      avg_silhouette = cached$avg_silhouette,
      ch = cached$ch,
      prob_silh = cached$prob_silh
    )

    avg_silhouette[k] <- cached$avg_silhouette
    ch_scores[k] <- cached$ch
    prob_silh_scores[k] <- cached$prob_silh
  }

  valid_k <- k_vals[!is.na(avg_silhouette[k_vals])]
  if (length(valid_k) == 0) return(NULL)

  pd_results <- data.frame(
    Method = "PD",
    k = k_vals,
    Silhouette = avg_silhouette[k_vals],
    CH = ch_scores[k_vals],
    ProbSilh = prob_silh_scores[k_vals]
  )

  best_k <- k_vals[which.max(avg_silhouette[k_vals])]
  best_params <- pd_results[pd_results$k == best_k, ]

  best_model <- results[[best_k]]$model
  best_labels <- results[[best_k]]$labels
  best_sil <- results[[best_k]]$silhouette
  final_avg_sil <- results[[best_k]]$avg_silhouette
  best_prob_silh <- results[[best_k]]$prob_silh

  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    UserID = user_ids,
    Cluster = best_labels
  )

  pca <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]

  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(best_labels)
  )

  list(
    embedding_path = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids = user_ids,
    pd_results = pd_results,
    results = results,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_params = best_params,
    best_model = best_model,
    best_labels = best_labels,
    best_sil = best_sil,
    best_prob_silh = best_prob_silh,
    final_avg_sil = final_avg_sil,
    cluster_df = cluster_df,
    dmat = dmat,
    pca_df = pca_df,
    var_explained = var_explained
  )
}

```



# 3. Evaluate PD across k
```{r eval-pd}
# PD: CHOOSE NUMBER OF CLUSTERS
# We evaluate k = 2 to 20 using:
# - average silhouette width
# - Calinski-Harabasz (CH) index
# - probability silhouette

evaluate_pd <- function(x, k_vals, dmat, embedding_path, embedding_tag) {
  runtime_sec <- rep(NA_real_, max(k_vals))
  status <- rep("ok", max(k_vals))
  notes <- rep(NA_character_, max(k_vals))

  results <- vector("list", length = max(k_vals))
  avg_silhouette <- rep(NA_real_, max(k_vals))
  ch_scores <- rep(NA_real_, max(k_vals))
  prob_silh_scores <- rep(NA_real_, max(k_vals))

  for (k in k_vals) {
    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/pd_cache",
      paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k, ".rds")
    )

    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cat("Loading cached result for", embedding_tag, "k =", k, "\n")
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)

      model <- cached$model
      labels <- cached$labels
      sil <- cached$silhouette
      avg_sil <- cached$avg_silhouette
      ch_val <- cached$ch
      prob_silh <- cached$prob_silh
    } else {
      cat("Running PDC for", embedding_tag, "k =", k, "\n")

      t0 <- Sys.time()
      model <- tryCatch(
      PDC(x, k = k),
      warning = function(w) {
        status[k] <<- "warning"
        notes[k] <<- conditionMessage(w)
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      },
      error = function(e) {
        status[k] <<- "error"
        notes[k] <<- conditionMessage(e)
        NULL
      }
      )
      runtime_sec[k] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
      if (is.null(model)) next
      
      labels <- model$label
      sil <- silhouette(labels, dmat)
      avg_sil <- mean(sil[, 3])

      ch_val <- intCriteria(
        traj = x,
        part = as.integer(labels),
        crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
      )$calinski_harabasz

      prob_silh <- Silh(model$probability)

      saveRDS(
        list(
          model = model,
          labels = labels,
          silhouette = sil,
          avg_silhouette = avg_sil,
          ch = ch_val,
          prob_silh = prob_silh,
          k = k,
          embedding_path = embedding_path
        ),
        cache_file
      )
    }

    avg_silhouette[k] <- avg_sil
    ch_scores[k] <- ch_val
    prob_silh_scores[k] <- prob_silh

    results[[k]] <- list(
      model = model,
      labels = labels,
      silhouette = sil,
      avg_silhouette = avg_sil,
      ch = ch_val,
      prob_silh = prob_silh
    )
  }

  pd_results <- data.frame(
    Method = "PD",
    k = k_vals,
    Silhouette = avg_silhouette[k_vals],
    CH = ch_scores[k_vals],
    ProbSilh = prob_silh_scores[k_vals],
    runtime_sec = runtime_sec[k_vals],
    status = status[k_vals],
    notes = notes[k_vals]
  )
  
  saveRDS(
  list(
    model = model,
    labels = labels,
    silhouette = sil,
    avg_silhouette = avg_sil,
    ch = ch_val,
    prob_silh = prob_silh,
    runtime_sec = runtime_sec[k],
    status = status[k],
    notes = notes[k],
    k = k,
    embedding_path = embedding_path
  ),
  cache_file
)

  list(
    results = results,
    pd_results = pd_results
  )
}

```

# 5. Loop over all embeddings
```{r loop}
for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {

  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }

  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_path, "\n")

  embedding_t0 <- Sys.time()

  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embedding_matrix))

  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

  full_file <- file.path("output/pd_cache", paste0("pd_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds"))

  if (file.exists(full_file)) {
    cat("Loading FULL cached result for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
    all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- readRDS(full_file)
    next
  }

  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

  eval_res <- evaluate_pd(
    x = embedding_matrix,
    k_vals = k_vals,
    dmat = dmat,
    embedding_path = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag = embedding_tag
  )

  results <- eval_res$results
  pd_results <- eval_res$pd_results

  best_k <- pd_results$k[which.max(pd_results$Silhouette)]
  best_params <- pd_results[pd_results$k == best_k, ]

  best_model <- results[[best_k]]$model
  best_labels <- results[[best_k]]$labels
  best_sil <- results[[best_k]]$silhouette
  best_prob_silh <- results[[best_k]]$prob_silh
  final_avg_sil <- results[[best_k]]$avg_silhouette

  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    UserID = user_ids,
    Cluster = best_labels
  )

  pca <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]

  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(best_labels)
  )

  runtime_total_sec <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), embedding_t0, units = "secs"))

  cluster_sizes <- table(cluster_df$Cluster)

  notes_text <- NA_character_
  if ("notes" %in% names(pd_results)) {
    tmp_notes <- unique(na.omit(pd_results$notes))
    if (length(tmp_notes) > 0) {
      notes_text <- paste(tmp_notes, collapse = " | ")
    }
  }

  cluster_sizes <- table(cluster_df$Cluster)

  summary_row <- data.frame(
    method = "PD",
    embedding = embedding_tag,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_q = NA,
    silhouette = final_avg_sil,
    CH = best_params$CH,
    prob_silh = best_params$ProbSilh,
    cluster_size_min = min(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_max = max(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_sd = sd(as.numeric(cluster_sizes)),
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    notes = paste(unique(na.omit(pd_results$notes)), collapse = " | ")
  )

  all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- list(
    embedding_path = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids = user_ids,
    pd_results = pd_results,
    results = results,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_params = best_params,
    best_model = best_model,
    best_labels = best_labels,
    best_sil = best_sil,
    best_prob_silh = best_prob_silh,
    final_avg_sil = final_avg_sil,
    cluster_df = cluster_df,
    dmat = dmat,
    pca_df = pca_df,
    var_explained = var_explained,
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    summary_row = summary_row,
    stability_info = list(
      seeds_tested = NA,
      n_runs = NA,
      chosen_k_values = NA,
      chosen_q_values = NA,
      ari_mean = NA,
      ari_sd = NA,
      stability_notes = NA_character_
    )
  )

  cat("Saved results for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
}
```

# 6. Show results for all embeddings
```{r results-pd}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  cat("Best k:", all_results[[name]]$best_k, "\n")
  cat("Best silhouette:", all_results[[name]]$final_avg_sil, "\n")
  cat("Best CH:", all_results[[name]]$best_params$CH, "\n")
  cat("Best probability silhouette:", all_results[[name]]$best_params$ProbSilh, "\n")
  cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
  print(table(all_results[[name]]$cluster_df$Cluster))
}
```

# 7. Plot tuning results for all embeddings
```{r plot}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  p1 <- ggplot(res$pd_results, aes(x = k, y = Silhouette)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Silhouette by k -", name))

  print(p1)

  ggsave(
    file.path("output/pd_plots", paste0("silhouette_", name, ".png")),
    p1, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )

  p2 <- ggplot(res$pd_results, aes(x = k, y = CH)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("CH by k -", name))

  print(p2)

  ggsave(
    file.path("output/pd_plots", paste0("ch_", name, ".png")),
    p2, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )

  p3 <- ggplot(res$pd_results, aes(x = k, y = ProbSilh)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Probability Silhouette by k -", name))

  print(p3)

  ggsave(
    file.path("output/pd_plots", paste0("prob_silh_", name, ".png")),
    p3, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 8. Plot PCA for all embeddings
```{r pca}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  p_pca <- ggplot(res$pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("PD Clusters (PCA Projection) -", name, "k =", res$best_k),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[2], 1), "%)")
    )

  print(p_pca)

  ggsave(
    file.path("output/pd_plots", paste0("pca_", name, "_k", res$best_k, ".png")),
    p_pca, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 9. Choose best overall embedding
```{r best}
all_best <- lapply(all_results, function(res) {
  data.frame(
    embedding = res$embedding_tag,
    best_k = res$best_k,
    Silhouette = res$final_avg_sil,
    CH = res$best_params$CH,
    ProbSilh = res$best_params$ProbSilh
  )
})

all_best_df <- bind_rows(all_best)
print(all_best_df)

best_overall_index <- with(all_best_df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
best_overall <- all_best_df[best_overall_index, ]
print(best_overall)

best_name <- best_overall$embedding
best_res <- all_results[[best_name]]

best_model <- best_res$best_model
best_cluster_df <- best_res$cluster_df
best_pca_df <- best_res$pca_df
best_k <- best_res$best_k
best_prob_silh <- best_res$best_prob_silh
```


# 10. Probability silhouette for best overall model
```{r silh-best}
Silh(best_model$probability)
```

# 11. Save per-embedding results
```{r save}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  write.csv(
    res$cluster_df,
    file = file.path("output/pd_results", paste0("pd_clusters_", name, "_k", res$best_k, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    res$pd_results,
    file = file.path("output/pd_results", paste0("pd_tuning_results_", name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(
    res$best_model,
    file = file.path("output/pd_cache", paste0("best_pd_", name, "_k", res$best_k, ".rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    res,
    file = file.path("output/pd_cache", paste0("pd_full_result_", name, ".rds"))
  )
}

write.csv(
  best_cluster_df,
  file = file.path("output/pd_results", paste0("pd_best_overall_clusters_", best_name, "_k", best_k, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  all_best_df,
  file = file.path("output/pd_results", "pd_best_overall_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

all_summary_df <- bind_rows(lapply(all_results, function(x) x$summary_row))

write.csv(
  all_summary_df,
  file = file.path("output/pd_results", "pd_summary_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
